takes.h: Lividian announces a signed, slipcased Decade of Darkness: Volume One by Philip Fracassi
takes.p: Lividian Publications announced on November 19 a signed and slipcased limited edition of Decade of Darkness: Volume One — Old School, the first of a four-volume retrospective of Philip Fracassi's short fiction. François Vaillancourt provides the wraparound dust-jacket art and six interior illustrations; the slipcase has a die-cut window.
